title: Vaquita
tagline: Vaquita helps you cultivate the habit of saving in a fun way.
description:
Vaquita is designed to build long-term savings habits through gamification and smart incentives, turning savings into an engaging experience where commitment is rewarded and early withdrawals are penalized, ensuring better returns for disciplined savers.


🕹️ How Vaquita Works

Dynamic Reward Pool
    Users who stay committed to their savings goals earn not only interest but also a share of penalties from those who withdraw early.
    For example: if 100 users deposit $100 each and 20 withdraw early, their generated interest is redistributed among the 80 who stay, boosting their APY from ~5% to ~8%. 
    
Game Theory Incentives
    Rewards are redistributed to long-term savers, encouraging consistency and reducing the temptation of early withdrawals.
    
Gamified Experience
    Users interact with visual elements (like cow avatars representing deposits) and track their progress in a fun, engaging way.
